PASS Bun 1.4.3 production adapter completed a 260-second silent request with configured HTTPS origin
Long-request probe command:
docker run --rm -v "$PWD:/app:ro" -v /tmp/continuarr-86-timeout.ts:/verify.ts:ro -w /app oven/bun:1.4.3 bun /verify.ts
Probe source follows.

import { createProductionHandler } from "/app/scripts/production.ts";
const SILENT_RESPONSE_MS = 260_000;
const CLIENT_DEADLINE_MS = 280_000;
const server = Bun.serve({
  hostname: "127.0.0.1",
  port: 0,
  fetch: createProductionHandler({
    files: new Map(),
    publicOrigin: new URL("https://continuarr.example"),
    async applicationFetch(request) {
      await Bun.sleep(SILENT_RESPONSE_MS);
      return Response.json({origin: new URL(request.url).origin, completed: true});
    },
  }),
});
try {
  const response = await fetch(server.url, {signal: AbortSignal.timeout(CLIENT_DEADLINE_MS)});
  const value = await response.json();
  if (response.status !== 200 || value.origin !== "https://continuarr.example" || value.completed !== true) throw new Error("Unexpected delayed response");
  console.log("PASS Bun " + Bun.version + " production adapter completed a 260-second silent request with configured HTTPS origin");
} finally {
  server.stop(true);
}
